title: HB1112 (2019 Regular): provide for certain persons to carry a concealed pistol or revolver without a permit.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2019-01-25; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/52301.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 52301, BillId 9899))
provenance.note: Introduced text 2019-01-25. Struck: 'Any', 'other than', 'who', 'his or her person', and the old closing 'is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor'. No vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (SDCL 22-14-9): A person, is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor if the person is not a law enforcement officer as defined in § 22-1-2 acting under color of authority, or a person who is a resident of this state who meets the requirements of subdivisions 23-7-7.1(1) to (5), inclusive, and subdivisions 23-7-7.1(7) to (10), inclusive, and: (1) Carries a pistol or revolver, loaded or unloaded, concealed on or about the person's body without a permit as provided in chapter 23-7; or (2) Carries a pistol or revolver, loaded or unloaded, concealed in any vehicle while operating the vehicle, without a permit as provided in chapter 23-7; Section 2 (new section in SDCL ch. 23-7): A person who is a resident of a state that allows a resident of that state to carry a concealed pistol or revolver without a permit, and that allows a resident of this state to carry a concealed pistol or revolver without a permit issued by that state, may carry a concealed pistol or revolver in this state without a permit issued under this chapter.
